CustomField.description: When checked, every run of this post-trigger action is logged however long it takes, even when Enable Trigger Performance Logging is off in Log Setting. Useful for diagnosing specific slow post-trigger actions during performance investigations.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Check to log every run of this post-trigger action however long it takes, even when Enable Trigger Performance Logging is off in Log Setting.
CustomField.label: Force Performance Logging
